input echo retired (2026-10-12): the hand-typed script_outputs['current_trade.json'] = {'type': 'FUT', 'instrument_type': 'FUT'} stub every one of the 31 seeded records carried is removed. It was redundant and contradictory, not evidence: the only reader was gate 1's option-instrument probe, which falls back to the record's own `instrument` field, while the stage-12 replay is fed the proof row's recorded_artifacts and its pinned replay_inputs.canonical_trade — and 36 of the proof root's 46 canonical fixtures state instrument_type CASH, so the stub asserted a value the recorded input contradicts. Retiring it restores the E1 rule it violated (a payload a gate reads must be a recording, never an extracted subset typed into the dataset), and tests/run_evals.py check_payload_coverage fails the run on any payload a record carries with no recorded artifact behind it. Curators must not write it back (tests/evals/curate.py, tests/evals/pin_legacy_records.py).

GB-2023-0003 retired from the quarantine register (2026-10-12, quarantine-retirement/1): stage 6 records real evidence now — an authored, disclosed financials bundle inheriting each record's own hazard level — so the rows' declarations flip quarantined -> recorded, the dataset `$ref`s point at the recorded bytes, the hand-typed payloads are deleted, and the E5 meter drops to 0 (baseline re-frozen). The pledge class now grades 5 of 5 with no abstention, and every earlier note calling these payloads quarantined legacy debt is superseded by this one. Authored by tests/evals/retire_quarantine_records.py.

42 of 52 records. The pledge (SCEN-007, SCEN-009, SCEN-011, SCEN-012) and earnings (SCEN-013, SCEN-014, SCEN-015, SCEN-016, SCEN-017, SCEN-062, SCEN-063) golden records are views of the frozen catalog's own hazard rows (business_test_cases.md §3) and carry recorded stage-6 evidence: real `6_fundamental_audit.py --record` stdout over an authored hazard bundle (tests/proof/fixtures/<id>/financials.json), so gate 2 grades both breakers (`promoter_pledging_gt_25pct`, `earnings_within_7d`) from proven bytes instead of abstaining. The hazard inputs are authored and disclosed per row (`authoring.hazard_evidence`, copied from the bundle, and `authoring.hazard_inputs` in the fixture): the catalog's documented level is used verbatim where it states one, and a disclosed value above the documented floor where it states only the inequality. The statement blocks are deliberately empty, so stage 6 emits null Piotroski/Altman/CFO-PAT metrics with `missing_inputs` naming every gap — absence, never an invented filing (E4). GB-2023-0003's legacy pledge payload was retired into recorded stage-6 evidence (tests/evals/retire_quarantine_records.py, E5 meter 0), so the pledge class grades 5/5 and gate 2 has no abstention left; institutional_distribution 0/10 remains unauthored.
